svg.title: Lab 08 — VLAN segmentation and ACL policy
svg.desc: Three VLANs reach Router0 over one 802.1Q trunk; per-VLAN ACLs decide what each may reach on the corporate server
svg.text: Lab 08 — VLAN segmentation and ACL policy
Three VLANs reach Router0 over one 802.1Q trunk; per-VLAN ACLs decide what each may reach on the corporate server
Switch0 tags it with the port's VLAN ID
ACL on the sub-interface is checked first
returns via G0/1; ACL on G0/1 or in the policy matches
Test every cell of the matrix — a wrong ACL direction looks identical to no ACL
VLANs separate broadcast domains; only the router (with ACLs) lets them communicate, so policy lives in one place.
ACL order, direction and the implicit deny decide the result: re-read the matrix after every change.
